title: IngestRecord
description: GET representation in the Ingest API (and the admin catalog).

data.description: The stored write model (BrandInput/ProductInput/VariantInput/AssetInput) with defaults applied. For assets: `rights` is the full effective Rights object (node default rights merged with the fields the brand sent), `provenance` the full Provenance with its defaults, and `files` lists every current blob (original and web/square/thumb, including renditions the node made itself) with sha256, width and height.

missing_files.description: Present for assets only (an empty array when nothing is missing); omitted for brands, products and variants. Files still required before the asset becomes visible.
